Overview:

**At MoFo, we couldn’t write our own success story without yours.** **Ready to write your story?**

Join MoFo as a **Operations Coordinator**on our Office Operations team!

This role can be based in San Francisco  
https://www.mofo.com/offices

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Operations Coordinator will provide general operational support for the San Francisco office, including conference services, hospitality, and event support (some after hours), and backup receptionist coverage. The Operations Coordinator will be responsible for the inventory and maintenance of supply areas and for processing orders for supplies and catering and invoices for payment, being mindful of budget constraints. They will coordinate with vendors and service providers to fulfill requests for material support and services essential to events and daily operations. This individual will also assist Facilities and the Sr. Office Operations and Safety Specialist in specified tasks and in backup support.

**Hospitality and Event Management**
====================================

* Work with the Conference Room Attendants to support conference services and hospitality for office events, including setting up and staffing events (some after hours).
* Conduct planning meetings with clients and internal meeting organizers, to coordinate meeting and event logistics, including timelines, room layouts, staffing needs and vendor services
* Order decorations and supplies for events, and collaborate with IT to coordinate audio/visual needs.
* Assist Hospitality and conference room personnel with ordering materials and providing services relating to maintaining meeting rooms and setting up for conferences.
* Assist the Facilities department with special events and projects.

**Catering and Purchasing**
===========================

* Establish and monitor office supply, stationery, forms, certificates, and equipment inventory levels, as well as ensure appropriate stock levels are maintained. Process requests for business cards and generate proofs for approval.
* Monitor and maintain supply levels in all supply areas.
* Ensure the supply room is consistently tidy and orderly, monitoring levels, ordering and restocking as necessary.
* Place and process orders for supplies and catering, including for the third-party Office Services vendor, and process invoices for payment, being mindful of budget constraints. Obtain items from local retail outlets when necessary.
* Receive, distribute, and store incoming supplies; quality check deliveries, process returns, and maintain accurate records of orders, receipts, and special requests.
* Directly assist trial teams with material support and logistics specific to individual trials. This may include ordering, packing and re-stocking supply areas when trial teams return.
* Maintain and oversee the restocking of medical/safety and survival supplies for San Francisco.
* Cross-trained to provide support for catering-related tasks, including placing catering orders for meetings as needed. Responsible for maintaining accurate Food Log data entries. Handles and ensures follow-through on last-minute catering requests efficiently.
* Work closely with vendors and collaborate closely with stakeholders on meetings and trial needs.

**Reception and Facilities Support**
====================================

* Provide backup receptionist coverage and carry out relief schedule for the Facilities help desk as assigned by the Office Services Manager or Facilities Manager. Relief may include the answering of external and internal phone calls, monitoring e-mails, and greeting and assisting visitors and personnel requiring assistance.
* Collaborate with Facilities department regarding furnishings and maintenance of premises. Such tasks may include lifting and moving of furniture or equipment, as well as perform minor maintenance on furniture and equipment.
* Provide departmental and third-party entities with any institutional knowledge that would benefit any transitions or daily operations of departments within the firm. This may include training on equipment, document production and essential protocol as it relates to operations and facilities methods and communications.

* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent work experience.
* Office operations or purchasing experience in an office environment.
* Proficient computer skills using Microsoft Office Suite required.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

* Ability to work overtime, including after-hours events.

jobs.description:
**Position Title** Senior SF STEM Program Manager

**Location**: San Francisco, CA

**About SMART**

SMART (Schools, Mentoring and Resource Team, Inc.) champions education equity by supporting students in overcoming systemic barriers on their journey to a college degree. We envision a community with equitable pathways to college graduation for every student in San Francisco. SMART provides a unique twelve-year continuum of support that starts in 4th grade and extends through college, including school support, after-school enrichment, summer programming, college prep, and college persistence support. As a result, SMART Scholars are more than four times more likely to graduate college when compared to their peers. Furthermore, while only 21% of low-income students who enter college will graduate within six years, SMART Scholars are currently persisting at a rate of more than 80%.

SMART’s Values:

* Community: We build a community that celebrates diversity, thrives on teamwork, and appreciates everyone’s contributions. Through community, we are stronger.
* Equity: We are committed to systems and processes that are just, fair, and inclusive, enabling all people the opportunity to belong, participate, and reach their full potential.
* Empowerment: We believe the path to empowerment and self-advocacy is through the encouragement, support, and guidance of those around us.
* Learning: We believe education and life-long learning enhance our understanding of our world, our place within it, and provide the tools to change it. Through embracing challenges and learning opportunities, we make progress.
* Joy: We center joy in our community and practice. We view joy as an act of liberation, which unleashes creativity, strengthens relationships, and propels the work that we do.

**Position Description**

SMART has partnered with the Crankstart Foundation to launch SF STEM at SMART, a new program for SFUSD students from low-income households who demonstrate strong math aptitude. The program recruits students in 5th grade and provides individualized STEM enrichment advising and funding through middle school.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Programs, the Senior SF STEM Program Manager will build and lead this program from the ground up. This team member will lead recruitment and selection of each cohort in coordination with SFUSD, serve as the dedicated advisor and single point of contact for students and their families, and cultivate partnerships with STEM organizations so each student is matched with opportunities that fit their interests. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and relationship builder, a self-starter who loves to collaborate, has an orientation to detail and ability to see the big picture, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

**Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):**

*Program Development and Management*

* In partnership with the Senior Director of Programs and Executive Director, build and launch SF STEM at SMART in partnership, including program design, systems, and processes.
* Develop, maintain, and implement the annual program calendar, including cohort meetings, student and family meetings, and events.
* Develop and maintain relationships with middle schools attended by SF STEM students..
* Identify and implement appropriate resources and support strategies for students and families.

*Recruitment and Program Enrollment*

* Lead recruitment of 5th grade and middle school students through outreach to SFUSD elementary schools, teachers, and community partners.
* With the support of the SMART Salesforce consultant, launch and manage the program’s application portal and process, including collecting supporting documentation from families.
* Coordinate the selection committee, including parent and student interviews and scoring applicants on a shared rubric.
* Onboard new students and families into the program.

*Student and Family Advising and Activities*

* Serve as the dedicated advisor and main point of contact for students and families from 5th grade through the fall semester of 9th grade.
* Work closely with families to help them navigate STEM opportunities, applications, and next steps.
* Support students in preparing and applying for after-school and summer STEM enrichment opportunities personalized to their interests.
* Plan and lead cohort meetings and events for students and families.
* In partnership with SMART staff, support 8th grade families in navigating high school application and enrollment processes.

*STEM Organization Partnerships*

* Cultivate and maintain partnerships with STEM organizations across the Bay Area and nationally to offer a variety of rigorous program options.
* Identify, match, and finalize each student’s after-school and summer program opportunities.
* With the support of the SMART Operations Manager, coordinate program logistics, including student transportation to the SMART office and to STEM opportunities outside of San Francisco.

*Data Tracking*

* Ensure student and program data is accurately and consistently collected and updated in SMART’s database.
* Use data collected to assess student needs and program effectiveness and to adjust the program model to achieve student and program goals.
* Collaborate with the Development Team to produce reports and talking points for the funder.

*Other Program and Organization-wide Responsibilities*

* Support and participate in organization-wide events as needed.
* Other duties and special projects as needed.

**Qualifications**

*Essential Qualifications*

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* Strong passion for issues of educational equity for students from underserved communities.
* Deep understanding of the challenges faced by students from under-resourced backgrounds.
* Experience working directly with underrepresented communities is strongly desired.
* Minimum of five years of professional experience, with a focus on working with youth, families, volunteers, and/or scho

jobs.title: Sales Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Join Galaxy Desserts

  

Galaxy Desserts, also known as Brioche Pasquier – Galaxy Desserts, is part of the Brioche Pasquier family of bakers, based in France. What really sets us apart is that we do all the crafting, baking, freezing and packaging ourselves. We carry three families of products: (1) Brioche; (2) Croissants; (3) Frozen Desserts, all dedicated to excellence and quality for Retail and Food Service. Our products are either made in France or manufactured at our facility in Richmond, California. Intensely committed to quality, we try and source all of our ingredients from the best producers we can find. We endeavor to mitigate our environmental impact and support our community every day.

Our core values are based on RESPECT: Recognition, Executive, Simplicity, Passion, Equality, Closeness, and Transparency. They shape our company culture and guide our business strategy. They bring together our employees and are integrated in our everyday work practices.

-------

**We are an applied AI lab building end-to-end software agents.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

Cognition is the company behind Devin, the AI software engineer. We’re hiring an Executive Engagement Program Manager to coordinate how our executives, Field CTOs and Managing Directors participate in our global executive programs.

You’ll start with a plan for each leader: their expertise, priority audiences and relationships, key forums and available time. You’ll turn those plans into a coordinated calendar across summits, customer advisory boards, executive sponsorship, briefings, dinners and major industry gatherings.

A strong working partnership with Sales is essential. You’ll need to understand account priorities, ask the right questions about requests and make sound recommendations about where executive involvement will be most valuable. You’ll balance those needs with our program goals and executive capacity, communicating tradeoffs clearly and pushing back constructively when needed.

This role sits within Executive Engagement and works closely with program owners, executive assistants, regional marketing, Events and Communications. You’ll bring structure and continuity to the portfolio so our leaders spend their time thoughtfully and each customer interaction builds on the last.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Build executive engagement plans. Understand each leader’s priorities, expertise, existing relationships and capacity, then maintain a proactive plan for their participation.
* Partner with Sales on priorities. Build trust with sales leaders and account teams. Understand which senior relationships matter, the customer’s priorities and why a particular executive or program would be valuable.
* Manage and prioritize requests. Establish a clear intake process that captures the audience, purpose, relationship context, timing and expected value of each request. Assess requests against agreed priorities, executive fit and capacity.
* Exercise judgment and communicate tradeoffs. Recommend what to accept, defer, redirect or decline. Offer alternatives where appropriate and route assignment decisions and escalations to the right owner.
* Coordinate the global calendar. Align executive hosts, audiences, preparation deadlines and commitments across programs. Identify conflicts and gaps early.
* Maintain continuity. Keep a shared record of participation, feedback and commitments. Ensure follow-up has a named owner and carries through between programs.
* Keep the team aligned. Run planning meetings, surface decisions and report on participation, capacity and program feedback.

**What you bring**
------------------

* Experience managing executive programs, executive briefings, customer advisory boards or similar programs in an enterprise environment.
* A demonstrated ability to partner with sales, understand account priorities and translate requests into well-defined executive engagements.
* Strong prioritization skills. You can distinguish an urgent request from a strategically important one, assess competing needs and explain your recommendations.
* Confidence asking sales leaders and account teams for context, challenging assumptions and pushing back constructively.
* Experience working with senior executives and their assistants, with sound judgment about how to use limited executive time.
* Clear, concise writing and experience preparing executive briefing materials.
* Strong organizational skills, discretion and attention to detail.
* The ability to build practical processes and personally manage the details required to make them work.

**Our Commitment**
------------------

**Equal Opportunity.** Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process - please let us know if you need any. Cognition also considers applicants with criminal histories consistent with the SF Fair Chance Ordinance and similar local laws.

**Data Privacy and Arbitration:** By submitting your application, you agree to our Global Applicant and Job Candidate Privacy Notice. For US applicants, by submitting your application, you agree to the Applicant Arbitration Agreement.

Experience working collaboratively with Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) and minority-serving institutions.

Spatial GIS Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Reporting to the Deputy Chief Information Security Officer, the Security Operations Manager is responsible for monitoring, detecting, protecting, and maintaining the security of data, systems, and networks at UCOP. This role includes managing the UCOP Security Operations team, monitoring the UCOP infrastructure for malicious activity, developing and implementing security processes and procedures, managing vulnerabilities, and coordinating security incident response. The Security Operations Manager will work closely with other units at UCOP, including infrastructure and application development teams, desktop engineering, and the service desk, to identify vulnerabilities, implement best practices, and ensure the security of the UCOP computing environment.

Additionally, this role provides mentoring to security personnel, drives continuous improvement, fosters an inclusive culture, and aligns the team with UCOP's mission and goals.

Responsible for providing research, analysis and solutions to address attempted efforts to compromise security protocols. Proactively addresses the negative impact on Office of the President caused by theft, destruction, alteration or denial of access of information. Advises departments on security prevention, best practices and secure software.  
  
10% Designs, configures and manages complex security systems including data loss prevention software, security information and event management systems, vulnerability scanners, and endpoint security agents. Administers security configurations to control access to information systems and networks including on premise and cloud environments.  
  
10% Directs incident response and forensic investigations and addresses and produces reports in response to highly complex or broad-scale security incidents. 5% Additional duties as required

jobs.title: Network Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us:**  
Effortless Office partners with our customers to make IT effortless so they can focus on their business. As a Hybrid Managed Services Provider (MSP) with a focus on providing world-class customer experience, we deliver and fully support secure cloud solutions as well as comprehensive managed IT and network services.

**About the Role:**

Effortless is looking for a Network Operations Manager who is an excellent leader and engineer. This is a player-coach role: you will lead our network engineering team while remaining one of the company's top escalation and design resources for enterprise, high-availability, multi-platform networks.

You will own the health, security, and continuous improvement of the networks we manage for our customers and within our own Switch data center infrastructure. We expect you to be proactive: you will not wait for tickets. You and your team will regularly review client environments, find risk, capacity, and performance gaps before they become outages, and bring clear, cost-effective recommendations to our customers and Service Delivery Teams.

The ideal candidate has served as a Senior Network Engineer, has the technical depth to earn the respect of senior engineers, and has the leadership skills to develop them. You set a high standard, communicate clearly, take ownership, and care about the customer experience.

**Position Details:**

**Reports to:** President

**Direct reports:** Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers

**Location:** Remote with a preference for someone in/near Las Vegas, NV.

**Travel:** Some travel required for data center work, client site visits, and special projects.

**Schedule:** Monday - Friday 8:00-5:00 PST, with 24/7 escalation availability for major incidents and management of the team's on-call rotation.

**Benefits:**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401K + employer match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Opportunities for career growth and development
* Training and certification support

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

### **Engineering Excellence**

* Serves as the company's senior network engineering authority and final escalation point in core routing and switching, network security, and network diagnostics.
* Designs, reviews, and approves complex network configurations and architecture, including hardware and software technology, site locations, business continuity, disaster recovery, and integration of technologies.
* Personally assesses and resolves the most complex data network problems and incidents, and leads major incident response through to resolution and root cause analysis.
* Owns the design, standards, and lifecycle of Effortless's own network infrastructure at our Switch data centers, including Cisco Nexus, Firepower, and SDWAN (Meraki and Cisco Viptela) environments.
* Sets and maintains network engineering standards, configuration baselines, and documentation requirements in IT Glue, and reviews the team's work for quality and consistency.
* Reviews analyses and technical feasibility to develop data network deployment strategies, resource requirements, and cost estimates.

### **Proactive Client Improvement**

* Leads a regular program of proactive network reviews across client environments to find security, reliability, capacity, and performance gaps before they cause issues.
* Uses Auvik monitoring, ticket trends in Autotask, and assessment data to identify recurring problems and drive permanent fixes rather than repeated reactive work.
* Assesses data network growth forecasts and ensures business needs are translated into network capacity requirements.
* Partners with Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, and ESAs to turn findings into clear, cost-effective recommendations for each client's technology roadmap.
* Tracks hardware and firmware end-of-life, vulnerabilities, and configuration drift across managed networks and plans remediation.
* Brings the customer's perspective to every recommendation: leads with business outcomes, not technology features.

### **Leadership**

* Hires, onboards, coaches, and develops Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers, including technical mentoring and certification planning.
* Sets clear expectations, holds regular 1-on-1s, conducts performance reviews, and holds the team accountable using EOS tools (Rocks, Scorecards, Issues, To-Dos) in Strety.
* Manages team workload, project priorities, and resource availability, and plans and coordinates cross-functional or cross-company work.
* Owns network change management: reviews and approves changes, maintenance windows, and rollback plans.
* Manages the team's 24/7 on-call rotation and escalation process, and ensures after-hours coverage meets Effortless's service standards.
* Communicates status, risk, and outcomes clearly to leadership, Service Delivery Teams, and customers, following our CWC (Communicate, Work, Communicate) value.

### **Operations and Compliance**

* Defines, tracks, and reports on network operations KPIs (see Success Measures below).
* Manages relationships with network vendors and carriers, including escalations, and supports procurement and licensing decisions.
* Ensures all compliance aspects of the position and team are known and followed; understands and complies with all policies, codes, and regulations applicable to the position and company, including client HIPAA, PCI, and NIST requirements.
* Maintains sensitive and confidential information regarding company and customer information.
* Performs related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

### **Education and Work Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, or a related technical field
* 10+ years of experience with Service Provider, MSP, or enterprise networking or general telecommunications
* 3+ years in a Senior Network Engineer (or equivalent) role, serving as the top escalation and design resource for complex networks (required)
* 2+ year

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition & Onboarding Coordinator
jobs.description:

Effortless Office partners with our customers to make IT effortless so they can focus on their business. As a Hybrid Managed Services Provider (MSP) with a focus on providing world-class customer experience, we deliver and fully support secure cloud solutions as well as comprehensive managed IT and network services.
  
  
**About the Role:**  
The Talent Acquisition & Onboarding Coordinator partners with the Experience Manager to attract, hire, onboard, and develop the people who make Effortless Office special. This role supports the full hiring lifecycle, from interviewing candidates and completing background and reference checks to preparing and sending offer letters, and makes sure every new hire has a smooth, welcoming start. They coordinate onboarding and new hire training, track and process 45-day and 90-day performance reviews, and manage the annual company review cycle from kickoff through completion. With a strong eye for detail and a commitment to confidentiality, the Talent Acquisition & Onboarding Coordinator creates a consistent, effortless experience for every candidate and employee, from the first interview through every review.  
  
**Location:** 100% Remote  
**Reports To:** Experience Manager  
**Schedule:** Monday – Friday 8:00 am – 5:00 pm PST  
**Compensation:** $55,000 – $60,000 annually  
**Benefits:**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401K + employer match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Opportunities for career growth and development
* Formal and structured mentorship
* Training and certification support

  
**Responsibilities:**  
**Recruiting & Interviewing**

* Partner with the Experience Manager and hiring managers to understand staffing needs and post open positions on job boards and other recruiting channels.
* Screen resumes and applications and conduct initial screening interviews via Microsoft Teams to identify qualified candidates.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews, participate in interviews, and gather feedback from hiring teams.
* Communicate promptly and professionally with candidates throughout the hiring process and keep candidate records accurate and up to date.

**Background Checks, References & Offers**

* Initiate and track background checks, ensuring each is completed and cleared before a new hire’s start date.
* Conduct professional reference checks and summarize findings for the Experience Manager and hiring manager.
* Prepare and send offer letters, track acceptances, and confirm start dates with new hires and their managers.
* Handle all candidate and employee information with strict confidentiality and in line with company policy and employment regulations.

**Onboarding & New Hire Training**

* Coordinate onboarding from offer acceptance through the first 90 days, ensuring new hire paperwork and PEO enrollment are completed accurately and on time.
* Work with hiring managers, IT, and Accounting so new hires have the equipment, system access, and information they need on day one.
* Schedule and facilitate new hire orientation and training on company policies, core values, and our EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) practices.
* Track completion of required new hire training, including security awareness training.
* Serve as a go-to resource for new hires during their first weeks with the company.

**Performance Reviews**

* Schedule, track, and process 45-day and 90-day performance reviews for all new hires, ensuring they are completed on time.
* Prepare review materials for managers and follow up on outstanding or overdue reviews.
* Manage the annual company review cycle, including timelines, communications, manager reminders, and completion tracking.
* Maintain accurate review documentation and report on completion status and trends to the Experience Manager.

**Employee Experience & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain organized, accurate, and confidential employee and hiring records.
* Develop and refine templates, checklists, and processes to create a consistent experience for candidates, new hires, and managers.
* Support the Experience Manager with employee engagement initiatives and other HR projects as needed.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.
* Preferred Certifications: aPHR, PHR, or SHRM-CP
* 3+ years of experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, onboarding, or HR coordination.
* Experience conducting interviews, background checks, and reference checks.
* Working knowledge of employment practices related to hiring, background screening, and recordkeeping (e.g., EEO, FCRA, Form I-9).
* Experience with applicant tracking systems (ATS), HRIS, or PEO platforms preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel.
* Experience in an IT, Managed Service Provider (MSP), or technology services environment is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple candidates and deadlines at once.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and a warm, professional approach with candidates and employees.

**Why Join EO?**  
At EO, our employees are what makes us special. We are a highly collaborative company with a very involved senior leadership team that invests in their staff. new_jobs.description:

**We are an applied AI lab building end-to-end software agents.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

Cognition is the company behind Devin, the AI software engineer. We’re hiring an Executive Engagement Program Manager to coordinate how our executives, Field CTOs and Managing Directors participate in our global executive programs.

You’ll start with a plan for each leader: their expertise, priority audiences and relationships, key forums and available time. You’ll turn those plans into a coordinated calendar across summits, customer advisory boards, executive sponsorship, briefings, dinners and major industry gatherings.

A strong working partnership with Sales is essential. You’ll need to understand account priorities, ask the right questions about requests and make sound recommendations about where executive involvement will be most valuable. You’ll balance those needs with our program goals and executive capacity, communicating tradeoffs clearly and pushing back constructively when needed.

This role sits within Executive Engagement and works closely with program owners, executive assistants, regional marketing, Events and Communications. You’ll bring structure and continuity to the portfolio so our leaders spend their time thoughtfully and each customer interaction builds on the last.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Build executive engagement plans. Understand each leader’s priorities, expertise, existing relationships and capacity, then maintain a proactive plan for their participation.
* Partner with Sales on priorities. Build trust with sales leaders and account teams. Understand which senior relationships matter, the customer’s priorities and why a particular executive or program would be valuable.
* Manage and prioritize requests. Establish a clear intake process that captures the audience, purpose, relationship context, timing and expected value of each request. Assess requests against agreed priorities, executive fit and capacity.
* Exercise judgment and communicate tradeoffs. Recommend what to accept, defer, redirect or decline. Offer alternatives where appropriate and route assignment decisions and escalations to the right owner.
* Coordinate the global calendar. Align executive hosts, audiences, preparation deadlines and commitments across programs. Identify conflicts and gaps early.
* Maintain continuity. Keep a shared record of participation, feedback and commitments. Ensure follow-up has a named owner and carries through between programs.
* Keep the team aligned. Run planning meetings, surface decisions and report on participation, capacity and program feedback.

**What you bring**
------------------

* Experience managing executive programs, executive briefings, customer advisory boards or similar programs in an enterprise environment.
* A demonstrated ability to partner with sales, understand account priorities and translate requests into well-defined executive engagements.
* Strong prioritization skills. You can distinguish an urgent request from a strategically important one, assess competing needs and explain your recommendations.
* Confidence asking sales leaders and account teams for context, challenging assumptions and pushing back constructively.
* Experience working with senior executives and their assistants, with sound judgment about how to use limited executive time.
* Clear, concise writing and experience preparing executive briefing materials.
* Strong organizational skills, discretion and attention to detail.
* The ability to build practical processes and personally manage the details required to make them work.

**Our Commitment**
------------------

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process - please let us know if you need any. Cognition also considers applicants with criminal histories consistent with the SF Fair Chance Ordinance and similar local laws.
